about: Goods: what places make, trade and need (good, good_material; a place's own rows are in stock/places/<place_id>.json `goods`). good_material names the material keywords or item kinds a maker of the good makes, so a thing made of them is local there (provenance).

goods.name: Iron and steel work
goods.about: Weapons, armour and tools forged from iron and steel by a smith.

goods.name: Hide and leather
goods.about: Hides tanned into leather, and the light armour made of them.

goods.name: Feathers
goods.about: Wading-bird and fellrunner feathers, dressed for fletching and finery.

goods.name: Sap
goods.about: Tree sap tapped and sold for medicine and alchemy (not the Hist's own).

goods.name: Eggs
goods.about: Bird and reptile eggs gathered for food.

goods.name: River fish
goods.about: Fish netted and speared from the rivers.

goods.name: River goods
goods.about: Whatever the rafts and rootworms bring down the rivers to be redistributed: the interior's crafts and the coast's imports.
